reviews.review:
Since there is no reviews yet i guess ill be first.

Is this game difficult. Yes. Is the game fun? Yes.

The idea of being near blind walking around checking corners and always expecting something? A nice change compared to other games. For this price especially. 

Some downsides because i gotta (Might change but its early access so get some salt)

Early game is rough when dying and losing your light source. running in the pitch dark not even a small light source is pain. Inventory management is something. grabbing every item is currently not of use since cant use weak items for anything (that i found)
stashing stuff is nice but very limiting (I dont mind personally but others might i like the challenge)

My 2 favourite features?
Music and Enemy design. Unique enough wheres its rare. but not uncanny to be weird. just a nice setting and design. and the sound design (even if lacking outside of certain areas) is amazing.
